correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of all feasible triples of facet planes, complete facet and edge enumeration, explicit sign counting in the only two generic symmetry regimes, octant partition, and spherical excess prove the full law. A standalone exact-arithmetic combinatorial verifier confirms 14 vertices, 12 facets, 24 edges and 96 normal representatives, with independent 240000-direction simulation. Exceptional wall sets have spherical measure zero.

value.rationale: The rhombic dodecahedron is the natural face-centered-cubic lattice Voronoi cell. Its Haar central section vertex-type frequencies form a specific geometric stereological observable: an exact six-versus-eight dichotomy, a coordinate-wise normal criterion, and a full exact probability distribution. These facts are motivated independently of their tractable computation; they are not an arbitrary slice or a recomputation of a known table.
